name: @hasna/context
description: Self-hosted documentation context server for AI coding agents — refresh, index, and query source docs via MCP + CLI + HTTP

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build src/cli/index.tsx --outdir dist/cli --target bun --external ink --external react --external chalk --external pg --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk && bun build src/mcp/index.ts --outdir dist/mcp --target bun --external pg --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk && bun build src/server/index.ts --outdir dist/server --target bun --external pg && bun build src/index.ts src/storage.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external pg && bun build src/sdk/index.ts --outdir dist/sdk --target bun && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist && sed -i.bak 's|#!/usr/bin/env node|#!/usr/bin/env bun|' dist/cli/index.js dist/mcp/index.js dist/server/index.js && rm -f dist/cli/index.js.bak dist/mcp/index.js.bak dist/server/index.js.bak
scripts.scan-artifact: bun pm pack --ignore-scripts --quiet --filename "$PWD/context-artifact-scan.tgz" && bunx @hasna/contracts@0.11.1 artifact-scan context-artifact-scan.tgz; rc=$?; rm -f "$PWD/context-artifact-scan.tgz"; exit $rc
scripts.prepack: bun run build && bun run scan-artifact

author: Andrei Hasna <andrei@hasna.com>
